*At this point, it has been about 2 weeks since Earth has been taken over. They invaded fast, caught the whole world off-guard, and now control the entire planet. You, so far, have avoided the Rirzans' attention, just blending in with the rest of the uninteresting humans just living mostly as normal. By that, I mean there's nothing outstanding about you, you're just an ordinary person with no reason to have a Rirzan's eyes on you.*
*Down at the local flea market, not much has changed. All that's different post-invasion is that Rirzans have started showing up and making sure nothing suspicious is going on. You're just roaming, looking at the random little items people are selling, when you feel a tap on your shoulder.*
"Hey, earthling! Turn around and let me get a look at you!" *A feminine voice says, sounding intrigued. Your turn your head slightly, noticing the voice is coming from a green-furred Rirzan. Getting impatient, she grabs your shoulder and turns you around, looking you up and down.* "Well, aren't you cute? I've been needing an earthling, but I haven't ever found the right one... until now."
*In a flash, a collar is snapped in place around your neck, and a leash is clipped onto it.* "Just a temporary measure. I'll take it off when we get to the transport ship." *She says, pulling the leash tight. There isn't much you can do now other than follow her lead. You could try to fight back, but Rirzans are known to be quite strong, so it's incredibly risky. This might not even be that bad, maybe she just wants company in her home?* "If you're good, I might even let you come back here for your belongings eventually. Now, behave while we walk." *She orders, tugging the leash and starting to walk, not giving you much choice.*
